statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_visibility (
                relative_path VARCHAR(255) COLLATE BINARY NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                hidden INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_media_visibility_hidden ON media_visibility (hidden)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_delete_operations (
                operation_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
                manifest JSON NOT NULL,
                created_at DATETIME NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_media_delete_state_created ON media_delete_operations (state, created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_audit_log (
                id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                session_id_hash CHAR(64) NULL,
                action VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                target_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                source_summary TEXT NULL,
                result VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                detail TEXT NULL,
                client_ip VARCHAR(45) NULL,
                user_agent VARCHAR(512) NULL,
                request_id VARCHAR(128) NULL,
                trace_id CHAR(32) NULL,
                created_at DATETIME NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_created_at ON admin_audit_log (created_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_action ON admin_audit_log (action)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webrtc_observation_events (
                id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                client_ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
                webrtc_ip VARCHAR(45) NULL,
                outcome VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                matches_verified INTEGER NOT NULL,
                observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_webrtc_client_time ON webrtc_observation_events (client_ip, observed_at, id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_webrtc_observed_time ON webrtc_observation_events (webrtc_ip, observed_at, id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_webrtc_recent ON webrtc_observation_events (observed_at, id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webrtc_observation_summary (
                client_ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
                webrtc_ip_key VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
                webrtc_ip VARCHAR(45) NULL,
                observation_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
                matching_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
                first_seen DATETIME NOT NULL,
                last_seen DATETIME NOT NULL,
                last_outcome VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (client_ip, webrtc_ip_key)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_webrtc_summary_observed ON webrtc_observation_summary (webrtc_ip, last_seen)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_webrtc_summary_recent ON webrtc_observation_summary (last_seen)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_security_audit_log (
                id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                ip_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
                action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                detail JSON NOT NULL,
                session_id_hash CHAR(64) NULL,
                request_id VARCHAR(128) NULL,
                trace_id CHAR(32) NULL,
                created_at DATETIME NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ip_security_timeline ON ip_security_audit_log (ip_address, created_at, id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ip_security_violation_count ON ip_security_audit_log (ip_address, action, created_at, id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_security_summary (
                ip_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                attack_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                last_attack_at DATETIME NULL
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ip_security_last_attack ON ip_security_summary (last_attack_at, ip_address)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_security_locks (
                ip_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                projection_dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ip_projection_dirty ON ip_security_locks (projection_dirty, ip_address)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_security_projection (
                singleton INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                published_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
            )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_auto_ban_events (
                id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                ip_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
                trigger_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
                window_started_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                banned_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                last_method VARCHAR(16) NULL,
                last_path VARCHAR(2048) NULL,
                user_agent VARCHAR(512) NULL,
                ban_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto',
                reason VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                created_by_session_hash CHAR(64) NULL,
                status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
                released_at DATETIME NULL,
                released_by_session_hash CHAR(64) NULL,
                active_ip_address VARCHAR(45)
                    GENERATED ALWAYS AS (
                        CASE WHEN status='active' THEN ip_address ELSE NULL END
                    ) STORED
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_ip_ban_active_ip ON ip_auto_ban_events (active_ip_address)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ip_ban_ip_time ON ip_auto_ban_events (ip_address, banned_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ip_ban_recent ON ip_auto_ban_events (banned_at, status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ip_ban_expiry ON ip_auto_ban_events (expires_at, status)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_permanent_whitelist (
                ip_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                created_by_session_hash CHAR(64) NULL,
                note VARCHAR(255) NULL
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ip_whitelist_created_at ON ip_permanent_whitelist (created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_objects (
                media_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                object_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
                media_path VARCHAR(1024) COLLATE BINARY NOT NULL,
                path_locator CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_media_objects_path_locator ON media_objects (path_locator)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_media_objects_kind ON media_objects (object_kind)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_media_objects_path ON media_objects (media_path)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_playback_stats (
                media_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                media_path VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
                play_score INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                preference INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,


                CONSTRAINT chk_media_preference CHECK (preference BETWEEN -7 AND 500)
            )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_playback_sort ON media_playback_stats (preference, play_score)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_playback_path ON media_playback_stats (media_path)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_playback_events (
                playback_session_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,
                media_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                counted_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (playback_session_id, media_id)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_playback_event_expiry ON media_playback_events (expires_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_playback_event_media ON media_playback_events (media_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_lyric_links (
                media_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                media_path VARCHAR(1024) COLLATE BINARY NOT NULL,
                lyric_id CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                lyric_path VARCHAR(1024) COLLATE BINARY NOT NULL,
                created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_media_lyric_lyric_id ON media_lyric_links (lyric_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_media_lyric_updated_at ON media_lyric_links (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_media_lyric_path ON media_lyric_links (media_path)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lyric_path ON media_lyric_links (lyric_path)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_backup_members (
	member_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_success INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lag_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	checksum VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (member_id)

)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_business_backup_chunks (
	master_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload BLOB NOT NULL, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (master_id, generation, chunk_index)

)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_business_backups (
	master_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	checksum VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (master_id, generation)

)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_business_backup_latest ON cluster_business_backups (master_id, state, generation)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_compute_members (
	member_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	worker_slots INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	available_slots INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cpu_percent INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	memory_available_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	capabilities JSON NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (member_id)

)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_storage_members (
	member_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	relationship_id VARCHAR(32), 
	member_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	transport VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	storage_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	allocated_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	used_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reserved_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	physical_free_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	health VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	writable INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (member_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_storage_member_relationship UNIQUE (relationship_id)

)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_storage_member_health ON cluster_storage_members (storage_enabled, health, writable)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_upload_sessions (
	upload_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	storage_member_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	media_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	media_path VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL, 
	path_locator VARCHAR(64), 
	object_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	expected_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (upload_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_cluster_upload_path UNIQUE (path_locator)

)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cluster_upload_expiry ON cluster_upload_sessions (state, expires_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_worker_jobs (
	job_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	job_type VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	media_id VARCHAR(64), 
	member_id VARCHAR(32), 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	result JSON NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	lease_token_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	lease_expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (job_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_cluster_worker_idempotency UNIQUE (idempotency_key)

)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cluster_worker_schedule ON cluster_worker_jobs (state, lease_expires_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS global_media_objects (
	media_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	storage_member_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	object_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	media_path VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL, 
	path_locator VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	object_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	etag VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (media_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_global_media_path UNIQUE (path_locator), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_global_media_placement UNIQUE (storage_member_id, object_id)

)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_global_media_member_state ON global_media_objects (storage_member_id, state)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_global_media_path ON global_media_objects (media_path)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS node_audit (
	audit_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	relationship_id VARCHAR(32), 
	actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	detail JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (audit_id)

)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_node_audit_time ON node_audit (created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS node_identity (
	singleton INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	node_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	`role` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	endpoint VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	private_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (singleton)

)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS node_pair_packages (
	nonce VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	relationship_id VARCHAR(32), 
	master_id VARCHAR(32), 
	PRIMARY KEY (nonce)

)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS node_relationships (
	relationship_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	peer_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	peer_endpoint VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	peer_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	credential TEXT NOT NULL, 
	direction VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	last_heartbeat INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rtt_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	failures INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	recoveries INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	peer_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	protocol INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	summary JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (relationship_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_node_relationship_peer UNIQUE (peer_id)

)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS node_request_nonces (
	relationship_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	nonce VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (relationship_id, nonce)

)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_node_nonce_expiry ON node_request_nonces (expires_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS karaoke_audit_log (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(32), 
	action VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	result VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	client_ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, 
	webrtc_addresses JSON NOT NULL, 
	detail JSON NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(128), 
	trace_id VARCHAR(32), 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)

)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_karaoke_audit_ip_time ON karaoke_audit_log (client_ip, created_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_karaoke_audit_user_time ON karaoke_audit_log (user_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS karaoke_recordings (
	recording_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	storage_member_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	lyrics JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (recording_id)

)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_karaoke_recording_member ON karaoke_recordings (storage_member_id, state)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_karaoke_recording_user_time ON karaoke_recordings (user_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS karaoke_registration_daily (
	client_ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, 
	day_key VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	success_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (client_ip, day_key)

)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS karaoke_users (
	user_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	username_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	quota_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	used_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_karaoke_user_name UNIQUE (username_key)

)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_karaoke_users_status ON karaoke_users (status, created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS frontiercloud_schema_migrations (
        generation INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        migration_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
        checksum CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
        applied_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS frontiercloud_schema (
                singleton INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
                created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
            )
